prompt.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a THREE-FRAME limited-animation key-pose SPRITE SHEET of this exact Song dynasty mill labourer emptying a burlap sack of grain onto a heap, seen from the same slightly high three-quarter angle as the reference. Keep his identity: blue cloth head wrap, grey-blue short jacket and loose trousers tied at the calf, dark cloth shoes, the SAME large pale burlap sack. The feet stay planted on exactly the same spot in all three cells; only the arms, hands, head and upper body move, with believable weight at the hips and knees. Cell 1 (left) = rest pose matching the reference: bent forward, both hands tipping the sack mouth down toward the LEFT of the image, a steady stream of pale grain falling onto a small heap on the ground. Cell 2 (middle) = lifting: he straightens slightly and raises the sack bottom higher with both hands, the stream of grain is thicker, the heap a little bigger. Cell 3 (right) = shaking out: the nearly empty sack hangs lower and limp, he gives it a shake, only the last few grains trickle out, the heap at its fullest. Fine ink outlines and muted antique Chinese watercolor exactly matching the reference, same line weight, same palette, same paper-grain shading. Truly transparent alpha background, no ground shadow, no glow, no grid lines, no numbers, no text. One single horizontal row of 3 equal-width cells, one full figure per cell, centered in its cell with generous margin so tools, cloth, grain and hands never touch a cell edge. Identical character size and identical camera angle in every cell. Redraw at higher detail than the small reference without changing the design. Make every cell match the reference figure and match each other as strictly as possible.
